decisions.reason: Turnaround management software sits at the core of the firm's data-driven integration strategy, has its own page, and is cheap to maintain, so the option remains valuable while airport sales cycles play out.

The connectivity module is still only mentioned, but as a low-cost add-on to the installed apron base it may become an enabler for integrated offerings, so its uncertain value justifies holding it another year.
Resource management complements turnaround software closely and can be bundled in end-to-end projects, so keeping it costs little while its standalone value is still being revealed.
The controller safety alert service extends the tower and traffic control offer, where long procurement cycles mean results are not yet informative enough to justify abandonment.
